property.value: A Digi-server. It stabilizes the server. Destroying it would likely fragment a LOT of data, among other things.

property.name: Flavor
property.value: This garbage looks like nothing... it's as if it was created to be junk.

property.name: Flavor
property.value: You hear a mouse somewhere in there for some reason.

property.name: Flavor
property.value: Angry eyes stare at you from beneath the rubble.

property.name: Flavor
property.value: You can see several viruses gluttonously eating at some of the garbage.

property.name: Flavor
property.value: A cyberstump. It implies a big tree, bigger than the ones near the Square.

property.name: Flavor
property.value: A cyberstump. Or is it cyber-stump?

property.name: Flavor
property.value: A big stump. You would sit on it, if it were shorter.

property.name: Direction
property.value: Up Right

property.name: Text 1
property.value: This is the dump. It's a bit stinky. Viruses and freloader navis have made the place their hive.

property.name: Direction
property.value: Up Left

property.name: Text 1
property.value: I see more and more garbage piling near the junk piles. Good! ...But at the same time...

property.name: Direction
property.value: Down Left

property.name: Text 1
property.value: I'm thankful for the officials making sure there's no evil navis or viruses here.

property.name: Direction
property.value: Down Left

property.name: Text 1
property.value: The aura from this Dark Emitter relaxes me. You, not so much.

property.name: Flavor
property.value: A cyber-stump. It stands like a decorative pillar.

property.name: Direction
property.value: Down Left

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Nope, haven't seen any virus around. Not a one.

property.name: Direction
property.value: Up Right

property.name: Text 1
property.value: It's been a few weeks now. You'd think there'd be more traffic, and that areas would get cut off at some point.

property.name: Flavor
property.value: A large block of cyber ice. It gives you flashbacks.

property.name: Flavor
property.value: A Light Digital World Emitter. In case something happens in the real world, this emitter will preserve Cyberworld.

property.name: Direction
property.value: Down Left

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Hah. The amount of officials has finally dwindled. Finally, we have some time to relax and prepare.

property.name: Direction
property.value: Down Right

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Fine. I'll try to keep this place clean. I just don't want the water to start killing us with its acrid fumes.

property.name: Direction
property.value: Up Left

property.name: Text 1
property.value: What! Go away.

property.name: Direction
property.value: Down Left

property.name: Text 1
property.value: How do we clean this filth? It's green!

property.name: Direction
property.value: Down Right

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Is it true, that these are but the tip of what is a pillar, that reaches a deep, dark dimension below? I wanna go THERE!

property.name: Direction
property.value: Down Right

property.name: Text 1
property.value: You're in my turf, now. Git!

property.name: Direction
property.value: Down Right

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Lag Key? I think someone from the Discord has it. This next area is pretty work-ish. Heavy industrial area!

property.name: Flavor
property.value: A Dark Digital World Emitter. In case something happens in the real world, this emitter will preserve Cyberworld.

property.name: Flavor
property.value: A lot of obsolete condensed data blocks your way.

property.name: Flavor
property.value: A data bloat has coagulated this path. It needs to be cleansed by an Official. Damaging it does virtually nothing.

property.name: Flavor
property.value: Kelee shoos you with a vulgar hand gesture.

property.name: Direction
property.value: Down Left

property.name: Text 1
property.value: You shouldn't sit over there! The gate connects to the Global Net! Who knows what kind of Internet creeps you'll meet there!

property.name: Direction
property.value: Up Left

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Can't wait for the water to be purfied! As soon as that's done, I'm going to the next area!

property.name: Flavor
property.value: Metto metto?

property.name: Flavor
property.value: A weird terminal. Peculiar, how it computes digital data... within a digital world within a cyberworld. If this device serves a purpose, it's clearly not obvious as to what it is.

property.name: Flavor

property.name: Flavor
property.value: Yup! That is a rock boulder all right.

property.value: This shiny rock is hard to break. Don't break it.

property.name: Flavor
property.value: A darker boulder... But not a DARKBLDR.

property.value: A deep pine tree. Its coloration is off.

property.name: Flavor
property.value: A very dense wall of errors bar the way.

property.name: Direction
property.value: Up Left

property.name: Text 1
property.value: This area is being debugged and worked on. What I'm here for, is to figure out what the creator's been doing, since he somehow slips past walls, doors, and even walks over water!

property.name: Flavor
property.value: A digi-server humming with power. You can't help but wonder where it gets this power from.

property.name: Flavor
property.value: A digi-server powering the flow of the water below. You get a feeling either it does not work, or the water is faulty.

property.name: Direction
property.value: Down Left

property.name: Text 1
property.value: WELCOME TO THE ONB PLAZA! THERE IS NO MEMES HERE, IT IS A GOOD PLACE TO JUST KICK DOWN, RELAX, OR GET LOST IN THE MANY SQUARES!

property.name: Direction
property.value: Down Left

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Try not to get lost! This whole platform leads to the lower one, but I don't know anything about what goes on down there, and don't drag me there!

property.name: Direction
property.value: Down Right

property.name: Text 1
property.value: I have a feeling this program has no idea how to code a teleporter either. I'm just waiting for a signal from the other side.

property.name: Direction
property.value: Down Right

property.name: Text 1
property.value: I've noticed a fair bit of business. Maybe there will be a cafe?

property.name: Direction
property.value: Up Left

property.name: Text 1
property.value: THE PLAZA IS FINALLY OPEN. MY JOB IS TO GREET YOU. HELLO! WELL, MY JOB IS DONE.

property.name: Direction
property.value: Up Right

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Just between you and me... Who's your... 'favorite'? Mine is Keristero. Don't tell!

property.name: Direction
property.value: Down Left

property.name: Text 1
property.value: This is the Central Square. The road-lined path is the Main Road. It cycles through the major squares.

property.name: Direction
property.value: Up Right

property.name: Text 1
property.value: AUGH, GREAT! Seriously??

property.name: Direction
property.value: Up Left

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Goodness! Apparently, the Business Area is bustling with fire viruses! Where are the Aqua-type navis?

property.name: Direction
property.value: Down Left

property.name: Text 1
property.value: How many Squares have you found? You can identify them by the pillars like this one, on the island.

property.name: Direction
property.value: Down Left

property.name: Text 1
property.value: THANKS FOR TAKING THE TIME TO TALK TO ME. IT MEANS I GET TO STAY HERE, INSTEAD OF GETTING DELETED FOR BEING USELESS, LIKE MY BROTHER NEAR THE TELEPORTS.

property.name: Direction
property.value: Up Left

property.name: Text 1
property.value: I'm done with this square. I'm off to the next area. I hear it's got an Arena in the works. I could work there, maybe?

property.name: Direction
property.value: Up Left

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Only Officials and Admins can go to this area. I hear it has very little to do with security, and more about... Oops, I'm speaking too much!

property.name: Flavor
